human_triage.evidence: The call is a test-only spawk process expectation for a fixed touch command. No production reachability or attacker-controlled command was established.

The GitHub OIDC request URL and bearer token are supplied by the same CI environment authority. Review did not establish a distinct lower-privilege actor controlling only the destination or a privilege gain.

The source comment and tests define workspaces as owner-managed and intentionally exempt them from allowScripts, while ignoreScripts still gates lifecycle execution at lines 147-164. No independent attacker path into an owner-managed workspace was established.
missing_for_vulnerability: attacker-controlled workspace insertion under a supported threat model

scanner_learning: Rank test-only evidence below production evidence without blanket test exclusion.
Model authority equivalence when a single CI principal controls both a URL and its credential.
Retain intentional policy exceptions as abstentions unless an independent attacker path and supported invariant are proven.
claim_boundary: This is traceable local source triage of scanner abstentions, not a complete npm security audit, clean bill of health, disclosed vulnerability, or independently reproduced result.
